findingsSummary: Two deal breakers triggered. The OPERATOR EOA can drain the entire vault balance (~$12M) via moveAssets() with no multisig, no timelock, and no per-call cap. The Oracle REPORTER EOA can set arbitrary share prices because the rate limiter (maxPpsMoveBps) is configured to 0 (disabled) and the ADMIN EOA can re-disable it at any time. All six privileged roles across NavVault and NavOracle are EOAs — no multisig, no DAO, no on-chain governance. The deal-breaker gate fails on EOA fund control and manual price control.

ADMIN EOA can change liquidityRecipient instantly via setLiquidityRecipient() — no timelock

dealBreakerDetails.evidence: Not a proxy. No upgrade mechanism.

OPERATOR (EOA 0x0398...8813) calls moveAssets() to transfer all vault funds to liquidityRecipient (EOA 0xFC45...0ADf). ADMIN (EOA 0xbF33...ef6E) can change recipient instantly. No multisig, no timelock, no cap.
No governance token.
No governance mechanism.
Oracle replacement has 1-day timelock. No bypass functions found (emergencyExecute, fastTrack, etc.). No timelock on moveAssets, setLiquidityRecipient, setExitFeeBps, setEpochSeconds.
pause()/unpause() via GUARDIAN role on both vault and oracle.
Managed single-asset vault. Share price from admin-reported NAV; no DEX pool oracle.

REPORTER (EOA 0x12f8...3D967) calls reportNav(pps, ts) on NavOracle to set arbitrary PPS. maxPpsMoveBps = 0 → rate limiter disabled. No governance approval. No timelock. ADMIN can re-disable rate limiter at any time via setConfig().
Solidity ^0.8.21. No known CVEs.
ReentrancyGuard (nonReentrant) on all 15 state-changing fund functions.
Shares minted only via ERC4626 deposit()/mint() — requires matching asset transfer.
No delegatecall or .call{} in custom code.
Not a proxy.
No initializer. Constructor only.
TVL ~$12M. 3 audits: Adevarlabs (Dec 2025), Omniscia (Jan 2026), Sherlock (Feb 2026).
2/2 core contracts verified (NavVault, NavOracle).
No critical/high unfixed issues known (audit report details not reviewed in detail per scope).
Oracle-driven NAV not manipulable via flash loans (PPS set off-chain by REPORTER). Instant withdrawals limited by vault liquidity.
~5.7% return since inception. Strategies: market making, basis/funding arb, RWA. No unsustainable emission.

adminControlMatrix.worstCase: Transfer the entire vault balance (~$12M) to liquidityRecipient in a single transaction
Redirect the moveAssets() destination to any address; in combination with OPERATOR a single ADMIN+OPERATOR coordination drains funds anywhere
Set arbitrary PPS — inflate to extract from depositors or deflate to dilute existing holders. Rate limiter disabled (maxPpsMoveBps = 0)
Re-disable maxPpsMoveBps or change staleness window; renders any future rate-limit hardening unenforceable
Replace the NAV oracle with an attacker-controlled implementation. The 1-day timelock is the only public delay window in the entire protocol
Block user deposits/withdrawals indefinitely (denial-of-service); does not enable theft on its own

openIssues.issue: OPERATOR EOA can drain vault via moveAssets()
openIssues.recommendation: Migrate OPERATOR to multisig (3/5 minimum). Add timelock or per-epoch cap to moveAssets().

openIssues.issue: Oracle REPORTER can set arbitrary PPS
openIssues.impact: Share price manipulation → extraction or dilution
openIssues.recommendation: Enable maxPpsMoveBps (e.g., 100 = 1% max move per update). Migrate REPORTER to multisig or MPC.

openIssues.issue: All roles are EOAs, no multisig
openIssues.impact: Single key compromise = full protocol control
openIssues.recommendation: Migrate DEFAULT_ADMIN, OPERATOR, GUARDIAN to multisigs. Use hardware wallets for all signers.

openIssues.impact: ADMIN can redirect fund destination instantly

openIssues.issue: ADMIN can re-disable oracle rate limiter
openIssues.recommendation: Consider making rate-limiter floor immutable or require governance approval to lower it.
Launch bug bounty on Immunefi with meaningful rewards (>$100K max).
